propositions: Config-driven link-relation mapping must apply the same effective link_map to both ADD (_diff_links) and REMOVE (_diff_link_removals) paths via a shared _resolve_link resolver
Skip directive must be symmetric: a relation marked skip emits no ADD mutation and suppresses any REMOVE mutation, never substituting an approximate link type
Remote link REMOVE attribution must be config-aware: when a remote link carries an overridden vendor type, the inverted link_map must recover its local relation to prevent spurious adoption or drop
Undeclared link types must fail closed: effective_link_map must validate that all link_map values (except SKIP) belong to the declared link_types vocabulary, raising MappingConfigError on violation

ADD and REMOVE must reference a single opaque_vendor_type: link_type overrides compose with preserved built-in swap semantics, and remove operations emit the actual (overridden) remote type, not re-substituted variants
